What is the most popular wall painting trend for 2026?

The core trend for 2026 is “decorative artistic borders.” Instead of full-wall coverage, hand-painted patterned borders are used to highlight architectural details, adding personality and playfulness to the space.
What is artistic paint, and how does it differ from regular emulsion paint?

While regular paint offers color and flatness, Kabel Artistic Paint uses specialized formulas and application techniques to create 3D textures, metallic sheens, or velvet-like visual effects, transforming walls into works of art.
What is “Sensory Aesthetics,” and how is it reflected in your products?
It refers to the fusion of sight and touch. Kabel products offer not just beautiful colors, but also tactile sensations like grit, silk, and leather, satisfying a full range of sensory experiences.
Why choose Kabel instead of other brands?
Because Kabel perfectly merges “top-tier formaldehyde-purifying tech” with “Italian artistic aesthetics.” We don’t just sell paint; we provide a one-stop solution for spatial aesthetics and wellness.
How many colors are in the Kabel artistic paint library?
We have thousands of digitally formulated colors and support personalized customization based on 2026 fashion trends.
Can I apply artistic paint directly over old emulsion paint?
If the old wall is firm, flat, and free of hollows, it can be applied after using a Kabel-specific primer. However, we recommend a wall assessment by a professional technician.
Is artistic paint suitable for modern minimalist styles?
Absolutely. Our Micro-cement series and premium matte textures are the perfect companions for minimalist styles, adding depth and a sense of luxury to the space.
How does artistic paint look in rooms with poor natural light?
Artistic paints with metallic reflective effects or silk textures can bounce light around, effectively enhancing the visual brightness of darker rooms.
Is “core-shell copolymer” harmful to the human body?
Not at all. It is a high-tech molecular structure designed to act as a formaldehyde trap; its physical and chemical properties are extremely stable and eco-friendly.
Will artistic paint fade over time?
No. Kabel uses high-quality weather-resistant pigments with excellent UV resistance, ensuring colors stay vibrant and fresh for years.
Can Kabel’s formaldehyde-purifying artistic paint actually purify the air?

Yes. We utilize advanced “core-shell copolymer” technology that actively adsorbs and decomposes free formaldehyde molecules in the air, converting them into harmless substances to continuously protect home wellness.
Is artistic paint suitable for humid environments, such as the rainy season?
Absolutely. Kabel artistic paint features excellent anti-mold and moisture-resistant properties; its breathability effectively prevents peeling or mold growth on walls.
Is this paint scrub-resistant? What if children stain the walls?
Our artistic paints are highly wear-resistant. Most stains can be removed by simply wiping with a damp cloth without damaging the artistic texture of the wall.
How long does the application process typically take?
It depends on the complexity. Basic textures usually take 3–5 days, involving multiple stages—including primer, mid-coat, and artistic topcoat—to ensure a perfect finish.
Are Kabel’s artistic paints water-based or oil-based?

Singapore, a vibrant land where Eastern and Western cultures converge, holds the colourful heritage of Nanyang shophouses alongside the modern skyline of Marina Bay. It embraces profound traditions of the Chinese community while resonating with cutting-edge global trends. As Kabel Decorative Coatings sets foot in this culturally diverse territory for the first time, a dialogue spanning space, culture and art begins.
July 2026 — Multicultural Singapore gains a new artistic landmark. Kabel Decorative Coatings opens its first premium custom showroom in Singapore.
After Hong Kong, China and Taiwan, China, this is a key milestone for Kabel’s overseas development, accelerating the brand’s global expansion.

Local designers, partners and guests came together for the grand opening. Festive lion & dragon dances, lively drum performances and the ribbon-cutting ceremony filled the day with joy and good fortune.
Trendy mascot interactions and refreshments united modern style and Nanyang culture, offering guests a comfortable space for communication.

Kabel Premium Custom Showroom in Singapore showcases Kabel’s full product portfolio. Through full-scale real sample feature walls, it intuitively demonstrates the outstanding performance of its products in colour, texture and tactility.

During the tour and exchanges, emerging local designers noted that the rich textures and eco-friendly properties of Kabel Decorative Coatings align perfectly with the demand for personalised and sustainable design in today’s high-end residential and commercial spaces, bringing brand-new creative inspiration to the local market.
Anchor in the Lion City: Kabel’s Strategic Pivot for Global Expansion

Why Singapore? As the commercial and design heart of Southeast Asia, the city-state is home to high-end residences, international hotels and boutique commercial spaces, sustaining robust demand for premium decorative coatings with superior quality and aesthetic appeal.

Meanwhile, Singapore’s stringent environmental regulations and strict market access requirements make it a natural litmus test. Only brands with comprehensive strength can gain a foothold here. By establishing its first flagship showroom in Singapore for global deployment, Kabel precisely targets the nation’s strategic value — acting as a hub covering Southeast Asia and paving the way for future expansion into European and American markets.
From its strategic hub in Singapore, Kabel aims to share its vision of “Art and Life” with more global consumers, enabling the aesthetic expression of a Chinese brand to reach the world.
Solid Foundation: Dual Endorsement of Technology and Aesthetics
“The essence of going global is not merely shipping containers of goods, but the transplantation of brand value and operational systems,” said Wang Hui, President of Kabel.
Guided by this philosophy, Kabel adopts systematic output for overseas expansion — fully rolling out its brand philosophy, service standards and operational methodologies.

At present, three independent overseas departments covering business, marketing and customer service are in full operation, delivering end-to-end support ranging from product supply to after-sales service for international markets.
Hard Power Backing Kabel’s Overseas Operation System: Technology and Aesthetics
Kabel’s overseas operation system is underpinned by robust strength in both technology and aesthetics.

In terms of environmental performance, Kabel’s self-developed patented “Formaldehyde-to-Water” technology achieves a formaldehyde removal rate of 94.1% and a long-term purification rate of 82.1%. The brand also conducts joint R&D of high-efficiency formaldehyde-purifying formulas together with a Nobel Laureate in Chemistry and Fortune Global 500 enterprises including BASF and Dow. Its products have obtained authoritative international certifications such as French A+, GREENGUARD Gold, Finnish M1 and EU REACH.

On the aesthetic front, Kabel has collaborated with Qiu Qingnian, inheritor of the intangible cultural heritage of traditional Chinese painting pigments, to launch the Heritage Collection. The line extracts classic Chinese mineral pigments including malachite green and azurite blue from A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains and Dunhuang Murals. In partnership with pattern specialist Chen Zimo, Kabel transforms traditional ethnic patterns into contemporary wall motifs. Furthermore, its products have earned prestigious international awards including the MUSE Design Awards Gold, French Design Awards Gold and London Design Awards.
Such formidable capabilities form the solid foundation for a Chinese decorative coatings brand to march onto the global stage.

From Hong Kong, China and Taiwan, China to the newly opened showroom in Singapore, Kabel is also advancing market cooperation in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and other Southeast Asian nations. Kabel Decorative Coatings is steadily expanding its global footprint.
This achievement not only demonstrates the brand’s comprehensive strength, but also marks a new chapter of its in-depth development within the international high-end coatings market.

Moving forward, Kabel will keep driving brand growth through innovative craftsmanship and design aesthetics, delivering living space solutions enriched with artistic value to global customers. It strives to make every wall a carrier of urban culture.

KABEL Redefines the Fifth Wall: Bringing Color and Materiality Beyond the Walls
For decades, interior design has focused heavily on walls as the primary decorative surface.

But a new approach is emerging: designers are increasingly treating the ceiling as the “fifth wall”, using color, texture and decorative finishes to create more immersive environments. Recent design coverage highlights color-drenching, decorative ceilings and material treatments as ways to create a more cohesive architectural experience.
KABEL believes this concept opens new possibilities for decorative coatings.
Instead of treating walls, ceilings and architectural details as separate elements, designers can use coordinated colors and textures to visually connect different surfaces.
A warm mineral tone can extend from the wall onto the ceiling.
A subtle texture can continue through an architectural niche.
A matte finish can soften the transition between different surfaces.
This creates a more immersive and unified environment.
This approach can be particularly effective in:
Luxury VillasCreating calm, enveloping residential environments.
Boutique HotelsBuilding memorable guest experiences through color and texture.
Designer ShowroomsUsing walls and ceilings as part of the brand experience.
Restaurants & Hospitality SpacesCreating distinctive atmospheres through material and lighting.
Premium Commercial InteriorsDeveloping cohesive architectural identities.
For KABEL, decorative coating is no longer simply the final step of interior construction.
It can become part of the architectural design itself.
Through color, texture, light interaction and material expression, KABEL aims to give architects and designers more freedom to create spaces that feel complete from every angle.
KABEL — Beyond the Wall. Into the Space.
